turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Monday starting off? Are you fully back in the swing of things after recovering from the flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling so much better, thanks for asking. I definitely needed a boost to get moving today, though, so I started my afternoon with a big glass of that slow-steeped cold coffee I keep in the fridge. Phoenix is still absolutely roasting, so something icy was a must.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds incredibly refreshing, especially with the Arizona summer heat. Are you heading into the ER for a shift tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am. I've got a long night ahead of me at the hospital. I'm actually just getting ready to head out and catch the late-night city bus to get to my shift.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: The late-night transit can be a quiet time to prepare yourself before a hectic shift in the emergency room. Do you usually get a chance to relax during the ride?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Usually, yes. I just close my eyes and try to zone out for a bit. It’s nice not to have to worry about driving and traffic, especially when I'm already anticipating a busy night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense, especially in your line of work. Have you and Tom managed to get any salsa dancing in lately, or has it been too hot for that?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually did go dancing over the weekend! We found a place with amazing air conditioning, which is the only way to survive dancing in Phoenix right now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to spend the weekend. Did you have plenty of energy for it, now that the flu is totally behind you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. My energy levels are completely back to normal. I even managed to prep some sourdough starter yesterday, though I haven't baked the loaf yet.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It’s great to hear you're feeling 100% again. Sourdough and salsa dancing are excellent ways to recharge. I hope your shift at the hospital tonight goes smoothly and isn't too overwhelming.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! You never quite know what to expect in the ER, but I'm feeling ready for it. I'd better head out to the bus stop now. Talk to you tomorrow!
